attributes.action: Ban the use if medical cannabis
attributes.additional_details: We are fed up with our houses smelling of this awful stuff. As well as it is causing health problems
attributes.background: We would like medical cannabis to be made illegal. Cannabis has been made available on prescription without thought of what it is doing to people that have to live next to or around it. From personal experience we have had so much problems from this due to neighbours smoking it constantly

rejection.details:
We are unclear about the action sought in this petition. The only medical prescription forms of cannabis available are oils, sprays and capsules. These available only to patients in very specific circumstances. 

More information is available on the NHS website: https://www.nhs.uk/medicines/medical-cannabis/
